definitions.explanation: A general term referring to various things, situations, or matters.
Used to refer to things in general, often in philosophical or abstract contexts.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {物事|ものごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think about things)
- {物事|ものごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧ (perspective on things)
- {物事|ものごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順序|じゅんじょ}→順序：05460_junjo⟧ (order of things)
- {物事|ものごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (attitude toward things)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧: a thing, concrete or abstract, often a single one; {物事|ものごと} is matters and affairs taken together, never a physical object.
- ⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧: an event or matter, usually a particular one; {物事|ものごと} means things in general, as in {物事|ものごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧.

USAGE:
{物事|ものごと} is often used in expressions about one's approach to life, philosophy, or general attitude.
